method: Circle-method round robin construction. Teams occupy fixed slots; each round pairs slot i with slot n-1-i, then all slots except the first rotate one place. For an odd team count a bye placeholder is added, so every team sits out exactly one round and plays every other team once. A second leg repeats the schedule with home and away reversed. Home advantage is assigned greedily to the team with fewer home games, then improved by flipping individual fixtures whenever one moves a home game from a team with at least two more home games to one with fewer; the result gives every team the same number of home games in a double round robin and a spread of at most one in a single one. Fixtures inside a round are listed by lowest team position. Teams are unseeded: there is no strength balancing, travel or venue optimisation, and no dates are assigned.
